original_target.name: episode_net_return_on_gross_entry_notional

original_target.serialization: retain exact numerator/denominator; decimal target to 12 places ROUND_HALF_EVEN
original_target.episode: one asset, one direction, first flat-to-filled exposure through natural flat or reversal closing leg; adds and partial closes remain in same FIFO episode
